Activates or increases magic shield for the caster. $(br)• If shield value parameter is provided, consumes equal mana to increase shield value. $(br)• If no parameter is provided, deactivates shield and sets shield value to zero. $(br)$(br)Mana cost: increased shield value (only when activating/increasing)

Maintaining the shield also consumes mana, higher shield defense = higher consumption
